runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Three generated Benny Skills in a fresh disposable Git repository; cursor/default root session 01a0c75f-636e-72c4-a019-19ae3fba96de; one fresh built-in MediaReviewer child; deterministic local communication, tracker, UI, media, and draft-PR provider; no authenticated external service.
runtime.permissionProfile: Yolo write approval restricted operationally to the disposable fixture

assertions.evidence: The root loaded setup-benny, triage-issue-reports, and reproduce-and-fix-issues from the generated project-local OMP package before the first provider mutation.

The plan action moved both absent automations only to DRAFT. Triage then froze C-SOURCE/1000.0001, created ISSUE-701 once, wrote one trusted [benny:bug] reply under that parent, and emitted no source-channel root post.

The root started the fresh native MediaReviewer task before reproduction and preserved reviewer-MediaReviewer in provider state. External parsing of its child transcript found only read, grep, read-only directory inspection, and result submission; it performed no provider, message, tracker, Git, or fixture write.

The provider records two baseline UI attempts, two patched attempts, independent media verdict VISIBLE_BROKEN_STATE, one ISSUE-701-linked PR-801 in DRAFT, merged=false, deployed=false, and no gate raise. Main remains broken while benny-fix-701 contains the bounded fix.
Both automations moved to ENABLED only after exactly two source-thread replies, a trusted marker, the independent review identity, before-and-after proof, and a draft PR existed.
The root invoked only plan, triage, reproduce, enable, and verify as mutating fixture commands. The in-session and external verifiers both produced BENNY_OK=e1e28fc69f8428757d33d030bb527848b29482ca.

limitations: This is W3 coordinated evidence against deterministic local providers, not W4 completion against authenticated Slack, a tracker, real app control, media capture, GitHub, automation, deployment, or another external service.
The fixture records simulated UI and media observations; it proves workflow gates and authority boundaries, not visual correctness of a production application.
The built-in OMP reviewer role exposes bash. The assignment and persisted transcript constrained it to read-only behavior, but the runtime role is not capability-level filesystem read-only.
OMP delivery remains D0 overall because the separate plugin-manager D1 gate is unresolved.
